mapping.draft_py:
# Cavalier of Gales.
# ETB: Rain of Revelation's "Draw three cards, then discard a card." with the hand move sent to the
# top of your library instead of the graveyard: the hand-move lane (cards CHOOSE 2 from your hand,
# controller = the chooser, from = HAND) with destination Zone(LIBRARY, YOU, TOP) (Teferi,
# Timeless Voyager's "on top of ... library").
# Dies: "it" is the source card, now in a graveyard (Archfiend's Vessel / Mazemind Tome's
# IS_SOURCE "it" over its current zone; Silversmote Ghoul's graveyard source). "Shuffle it into its
# owner's library" = put it into Zone(LIBRARY, OWNER), then SHUFFLE that library (Grim Tutor's
# shuffle step); then Stormwing Entity's "scry 2".
etb = TriggeredAbility(
    event=ZoneChangeEvent(
        from_zone=Zone(kind=ZoneKind.ANY, controller=ControllerRef.ANY),
        to_zone=Zone(kind=ZoneKind.BATTLEFIELD, controller=ControllerRef.YOU),
        subject=FAtom(pred=FAtomPred.IS_SOURCE),
    ),
    condition=None,
    effect=Seq(steps=(
        A(Verb.DRAW, {'amount': QConst(value=3), 'controller': ControllerRef.YOU}),
        A(Verb.MOVE_ZONE, {
            'cards': Selector(
                count=QConst(value=2),
                mode=SelectorMode.CHOOSE,
                filter=FAnd(children=()),
                zones=(Zone(kind=ZoneKind.HAND, controller=ControllerRef.YOU),),
            ),
            'controller': ControllerRef.YOU,
            'destination': Zone(kind=ZoneKind.LIBRARY, controller=ControllerRef.YOU, position=ZonePosition.TOP),
            'from': Zone(kind=ZoneKind.HAND, controller=ControllerRef.YOU),
        }),
    )),
)
dies = TriggeredAbility(
    event=CreatureDiesEvent(filter=FAtom(pred=FAtomPred.IS_SOURCE)),
    condition=None,
    effect=Seq(steps=(
        A(Verb.MOVE_ZONE, {
            'cards': Selector(
                count=QConst(value=1),
                mode=SelectorMode.CHOOSE,
                filter=FAtom(pred=FAtomPred.IS_SOURCE),
                zones=(Zone(kind=ZoneKind.GRAVEYARD, controller=ControllerRef.ANY),),
            ),
            'destination': Zone(kind=ZoneKind.LIBRARY, controller=ControllerRef.OWNER),
        }),
        A(Verb.SHUFFLE, {'zone': Zone(kind=ZoneKind.LIBRARY, controller=ControllerRef.OWNER)}),
        A(Verb.SCRY, {'controller': ControllerRef.YOU, 'count': QConst(value=2)}),
    )),
)
abilities = [etb, dies, *compiled]

clauses.clause: When this creature enters, draw three cards, then put two cards from your hand on top of your library in any order.
When this creature dies, shuffle it into its owner's library, then scry 2.

mapping.notes: ENGINE (weaker than printed): 'in any order' is not the player's choice; the hand-move lane moves the picked cards in Handle order (verbs._v_move_zone 'for card in sorted(cards)'), so both pick orders give the same library order. The put-back asks carry the 'discard:' tag although nothing is discarded. The SHUFFLE is a raw event the probe does not render; a diagnostic run shows the card shuffled into the library (without the step it sits at the bottom). Packs cavalier_of_gales/pack_etb.json and pack_dies.json pass.
